sections.title: About Flora & Fang: Guardians of the vampire garden
text: Spray them! Trap them! Collect coins and upgrade your gear!

Flora & Fang: Guardians of the vampire garden is a single-player or local co-op adventure that puts you in the shoes of one of two lovable vampire siblings, Flora or Fang, as they embark on a mission to safeguard their dad—the infamous Dracula’s—precious pumpkin garden.
Flora & Fang: Guardians of the Vampire Garden is the type of game that would’ve kept my friends and I entertained late into a…
Flora & Fang is a bit rough despite having a solid foundation and great visuals.
